summary: The 2026 LLM landscape is dominated by a handful of frontier vendors—OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and a fast-rising cohort of open-weight Chinese labs (DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen). Real-world adoption is increasingly driven not by direct vendor APIs but by enterprise aggregators (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx), which give broadly-available models an outsized footprint. Because much of the live research data references unverifiable or speculative version numbers, this ranking is restricted to models whose names and availability can be confidently confirmed.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Consistently the highest-volume model across OpenAI's direct API and Azure OpenAI Service, giving it unmatched enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications requiring multimodal and reliable performance

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Confirmed released February 17, 2026 matching Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing; widely available via AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex, driving heavy enterprise adoption.
models.best_for: Enterprise coding and agentic workflows at scale

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Google's flagship reasoning model available through Vertex AI with massive context, cited as a 'context window king' and backed by Google Cloud's enterprise distribution.
strengths: Deep Google Cloud / Vertex AI integration
models.best_for: Long-context document analysis and multimodal reasoning

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume, low-cost workhorse on Vertex AI offering a 1M-token context at a fraction of flagship pricing, driving large developer adoption for cost-sensitive workloads.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: 671B-parameter MoE reasoning model cited as the cheapest frontier-class model ($0.55/$2.19 per 1M tokens) with huge open-weight HuggingFace download volume.
models.best_for: Cost-effective reasoning and math-heavy tasks, including self-hosted deployments

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: Widely downloaded open-weight general-purpose MoE model that delivers near-frontier performance at a fraction of proprietary cost, popular across self-hosting and aggregator platforms.
models.best_for: General-purpose open-weight deployment at low cost

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most-downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and broadly available via AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI, making it a default choice for enterprise open-weight deployments.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Anthropic's fast, low-cost tier available across AWS Bedrock and Vertex AI, widely adopted for high-volume agentic and lightweight tasks.

models.name: o3
models.popularity_notes: OpenAI's dedicated reasoning model available via the OpenAI API and Azure, heavily used for complex coding, math, and agentic reasoning workloads.
models.best_for: Complex multi-step reasoning and agentic coding tasks

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: A leading open-weight MoE model with rapidly growing HuggingFace downloads and availability through Alibaba Cloud, especially strong in multilingual and Asian-market adoption.
models.best_for: Open-weight multilingual deployments and cost-efficient reasoning

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Europe's leading frontier model, available via AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI, with strong adoption among EU enterprises prioritizing data residency.
models.best_for: European enterprise deployments with data-sovereignty requirements
